audit_method.description: A payload-free audit sentinel variant was added only to Content in a temporary archive. Rust reported all 14 crate-internal exhaustive matches already enumerated by R2.

In a fresh state of the same temporary archive, the sentinel was removed and Content was marked non_exhaustive. Rust reported two cross-crate exhaustive matches in query_helpers. Temporary neutral wildcard arms were then added only to those two audit-copy sites; the complete workspace, including L4, compiled with exit 0, proving no further cross-crate exhaustive consumers.

obligations: has_any_text descends through HtmlFrame.body instead of classifying the carrier as a textless leaf
count_variant descends through HtmlFrame.body while preserving the predicate count contract
